title: SEBI - 0047/2007 — Bharat Infrastructure & Engineering Pvt. Ltd. v. Securities and Exchange Board of India
text:
IN THE SECURITIES APPELLATE TRIBUNAL
MUMBAI
Appeal No. 47 of 2007
Date of decision : 30.3.2007
Bharat Infrastructure & Engineering …… Appellant
Pvt. Ltd.
Versus
Mr. G.Anantraman, the Whole Time …… Respondent
Member Securities and Exchange Board of
India
Mr. Vineet Jagtap Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Nishit Dhruva Advocate for the respondent.
Coram : Justice N.K. Sodhi, Presiding Officer
R.N. Bhardwaj, Member
Per : Justice N.K. Sodhi, Presiding Officer (Oral),
We have heard the learned counsel for the parties. The appeal
is directed against the ex-parte order dated February 22, 2007 passed
by the whole time member of the Securities and Exchange Board of
India (for short the Board) issuing directions to the entities mentioned
in paras 4.2 and 4.4 of the impugned order. Admittedly, the appellant
is not one of the entities to whom any direction has been issued. It,
however, feels aggrieved by some observations made in para 2.35 of
the impugned order. The learned counsel for the respondent states
that if the appellant were to file its objections with the board within 15

2
days from today, the same shall be heard and disposed of in
accordance with law. In view of this statement made by the learned
counsel for the respondent, the learned counsel for the appellant prays
that he may be allowed to withdraw the appeal.
Dismissed as withdrawn.
Justice N.K. Sodhi
Presiding Officer
30.3.2007 R.N. Bhardwaj
Member
BBN
respondent: Securities and Exchange Board of India
